levels.name: Cambridge Lower Secondary

courses.subject: science
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 1 Science
courses.about: Made for 5–6 year olds: short picture lessons with big emojis, a question to tap after every idea, picture answers (no typing), word games and a 15-question tap-only Unit Test. 6 units: living things, ourselves, materials, pushes and pulls, sound, Earth and sky.

courses.subject: science
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 2 Science
courses.about: Made for 6–7 year olds: short picture lessons, tap-only questions with picture answers, word games and Unit Tests. 6 units: living things and habitats, growing up and staying healthy, using materials, light and dark, electricity, rocks, soil and weather.

courses.subject: science
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 3 Science
courses.about: Made for 7–8 year olds: extra-slow, cheerful animated lessons full of pictures and everyday questions, questions answered right on the video, picture answers to tap (no typing), easy tap-only labs and a home experiment in every topic. 6 units: plants, mixing materials, light and shadows, staying alive, forces and magnets, the Earth and the Moon.

courses.subject: science
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 4 Science
courses.about: Made for 8–9 year olds: slow, cheerful animated lessons with lots of pictures and everyday questions, questions answered right on the video, picture answers to tap (no typing), easy tap-only labs and a home experiment in every topic. 6 units: skeletons and health, energy, materials, Earth and habitats, light, electricity.

courses.subject: science
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 5 Science
courses.about: Fun animated lessons full of examples, a slower narrator and large subtitles, questions answered right on the video, listen-and-say word checks, a virtual lab and a home experiment in every topic. 6 units: flowering plants, sound, states of matter, digestion, forces and magnets, seasons and adaptations.

courses.subject: science
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 6 Science
courses.about: Animated lessons with a slower narrator and large subtitles, listen-and-say word checks, a virtual lab and a home experiment in every topic. All 6 units: the human body, materials, rocks and soil, food chains, forces and electricity, light and the Solar System.

courses.subject: science
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 7 Science
courses.about: 14 units of lessons with questions on the video, a large bank of auto-marked practice, printable worksheets, Unit Tests with 25 questions, a pre-reading pack for every unit and end-of-year exams.

courses.subject: maths
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 1 Mathematics
courses.about: Made for 5–6 year olds: picture lessons with counters, ten frames, number lines and clocks; every answer is tapped (no keypad); word games and tap-only Unit Tests. 8 units: numbers to 10 and 20, addition, subtraction, shapes, measures, time, halves, patterns and data.

courses.subject: maths
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 2 Mathematics
courses.about: Made for 6–7 year olds: picture lessons on tens and ones, adding and subtracting to 100, the 2, 5 and 10 times tables, fractions, shapes and symmetry, measures, time and data. Tap-only questions, word games and Unit Tests.

courses.subject: maths
courses.title: Cambridge Stage 3 Mathematics
